statement: Context-dependent QA provides both a prevalence estimate and a construction precedent: roughly 16.5% of NQ-Open questions have context-dependent answers and annotators find that up to 30% of questions in existing datasets have answers that change over time, yet for such questions the work crowdsources alternative contexts and their corresponding answers, multiplying one question into several (context, answer) instances.
